title: GTA 6 Broke The Pre-Order Record
yt_title: GTA 6 Broke The All-Time Pre-Order Record 📈 #shorts
description:
Sony and Microsoft confirmed GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game ever on their stores. Sensor Tower estimated about 9.69 million digital pre-orders worth $942 million before launch.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #Rockstar

lines.text: GTA 6 broke records before anyone even played it.
Sony and Microsoft both confirmed it's the most pre-ordered game on their stores.
Sensor Tower estimated about nine point seven million digital pre-orders.
Worth around nine hundred forty two million dollars.
That beat Cyberpunk's old record of eight million.
And that was before launch day.
